title: cardano-testnet status
description: Output of 'cardano-testnet status --json': the health of a testnet, found by asking every node in its manifest for its chain tip and its mempool, the node with the best tip where the chain is, and the node with the most blocks whether the other tips are on its chain. The schema is strict: it describes schema version 2 exactly, unknown fields are an error, and any change to the output shape bumps schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Any change to the output shape, including new fields or values, bumps it.

status.description: State of the whole network. "running": every node is ok. "degraded": some nodes are ok, but not all. "stalled": some nodes answer, but none is ok. "stopped": no node answers. "no-testnet": there is no manifest in the directory.

noTestnetReason.description: Why there is no testnet, when the status is "no-testnet". "dir-missing": the directory does not exist. "not-ready": it has genesis files but no manifest: the testnet is still starting, or it never became ready. "not-a-testnet-dir": it is not the output directory of a testnet. Null for any other status.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the command: 0 for "running" and "degraded", 3 for "stalled", 4 for "stopped", 5 for "no-testnet".

chainProducingBlocks.description: True when the exit code is 0: the status is "running" or "degraded".

bestTip.description: The newest tip of all nodes: the one with the highest slot. Null when no node answered with a tip.

chain.description: Where the chain is, as the node with the best tip sees it. Null when no node answered with a tip, or when that node did not tell.

era.description: Lowercase name of the era the node is in, e.g. "conway". It can differ from the era in the manifest, which is the era the testnet started in.

slotInEpoch.description: Slot of the best tip within its epoch, counted from 0.

slotsToEpochEnd.description: Slots until the end of the epoch: slotInEpoch + slotsToEpochEnd is the length of the epoch.

nodes.description: One entry per node, in the order of the manifest. Empty for "no-testnet".

name.description: Node name, as in the manifest.

role.description: "spo" for stake pool operators, "relay" for relay nodes, as in the manifest.

pid.description: OS process ID from the manifest, or null when the manifest has none.

pidAlive.description: Whether a process with this pid exists, or null when that is unknown: no pid, or Windows.

state.description: "ok": it answers, and its tip is fresh. "stalled": it answers, but its tip is too old, or it has no blocks yet. "unreachable": it does not answer, but its process may be alive. "down": it does not answer, and its process is gone.

tip.description: The node's tip, or null when it did not answer with one.

error.description: Why the node did not answer (an error, or no answer in time), or null when it answered.

stdoutFile.description: The node's stdout log, relative to the testnet directory, as in the manifest.

stderrFile.description: The node's stderr log, relative to the testnet directory, as in the manifest.

blocksBehind.description: How many blocks the node is behind the node with the most blocks, or null when it did not answer with a tip.

mempool.description: What is in the node's mempool, or null when the node did not answer, or did not answer this question in time.

txs.description: How many transactions are in the mempool.

capacityBytes.description: How many bytes the mempool can hold.

onLongestChain.description: Whether the node's tip is on the chain of the node with the most blocks (the first one in the manifest, when several have as many). False means that the node is on a fork. Null when the node did not answer with a tip, or when that could not be told: the node with the most blocks did not answer this question in time, or it switched to another chain during the check.

hash.description: Block header hash of the tip, hex-encoded.

ageSeconds.description: Seconds from the start of the tip's slot until the node answered.
